# AdventJS

> > AdventJS offers daily JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python coding challenges throughout December, created by midudev as a festive programming practice platform.

Inspired by Advent of Code, AdventJS provides Christmas-themed algorithmic challenges with varying difficulty levels. The platform includes a Discord community and Twitch streams for collaborative learning and problem-solving.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript challenges
- TypeScript challenges
- Python challenges
- Advent calendar coding
- Daily programming practice
- Christmas-themed algorithms
- Array manipulation
- Data transformation
- Easy difficulty challenges
- midudev
- Santa Claus themed problems
- Gift list algorithms
- December coding challenge
- Advent Of Code style
- Discord community

## Homepage & Overview

- [AdventJS Homepage](https://2024.adventjs.dev/): Main page featuring daily JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python coding challenges for December with Christmas themes

## 2024 Challenges

- [Challenge 3: Organizing the Inventory](https://2024.adventjs.dev/challenges/2024/3): Easy difficulty challenge focused on organizing inventory with data transformation techniques
- [Challenge 20: Find Missing and Duplicate Gifts](https://2024.adventjs.dev/challenges/2024/20): Easy difficulty challenge involving array comparison to find missing and duplicate items in gift lists
